answer: At dawn each agent must lock a small refundable stake before joining the market; the stake returns only after one full epoch of honest work. A shared reputation ledger acts like a ridge: one verified identity climbs it, but a swarm of fake identities each pays the same stake, so spawning thousands costs thousands of times more. Random peer audits sweep the nebula of new accounts and burn the stake of any cluster copying the same behaviour, making sybil farming unprofitable.
